svg.title: Melbourne Suburban Garden Master Plan — Reserve Style
svg.desc: Zone-by-zone garden transformation plan for a Clayton South property, showing plant placement, mulch zones, and shrub layers
svg.text: Clayton South, Melbourne · low-maintenance · shrub ecology
keep small mowable area · access + openness
consider turf mat or low clover for less mowing
Zone G — back boundary mulch + shrub belt
Kangaroo Apple (young) · Westringia · deep woodchip mulch · volunteer seedlings welcome
No pruning needed, no watering after yr 2
Remove or hard-manage before too large
Council green waste or contractor removal
